evidence.description: For frozen expectation corrections only; otherwise []. Quote complete relevant original text verbatim, including whitespace. Source matching proves provenance, not semantic correctness.

source.description: task_request, user_update:<persisted human update id>, or original_file:<task-start frozen relative path>. Never current outputs, generated files, URLs or edited workspace contents.

quote.description: Exact original quotation, without trimming, ellipses or corrections.

corrections.description: For frozen expectation corrections only; otherwise []. All changes must be covered. Before snippets must match uniquely in the active FROZEN code (even while revising a pending proposal). Include unchanged context to disambiguate literals. Keep driver, inputs, calls, assertion types and cases unchanged.

reason.description: Explain why independent original evidence establishes that the old expected literal is erroneous and the replacement is correct.
